atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Inserts one of Tailwind's style blocks (base, components, utilities) at this point in the stylesheet. Processed away by the Tailwind PostCSS plugin at build time.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines the declarations from existing utility classes into a custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Points at the Tailwind config file this stylesheet should be compiled with.

atDirectives.name: @screen
atDirectives.description: Expands to the media query for a named breakpoint from the Tailwind config.

atDirectives.name: @variants
atDirectives.description: Generates the listed variants (hover, focus, ...) for the enclosed utilities.

atDirectives.name: @responsive
atDirectives.description: Generates responsive variants of the enclosed utilities.
